scorer: builder self-score at phase 1 (written instruction + environment), before contract_review
pre_mortem: A strong solver reads the procedure, writes a reference for the plots-to-claim pipeline and fuzzes the package against it. The eight departures (plot divisor, R4 chart row, leaf loss on survivors, half-up indemnity, vanishing cap, minimum loss 8.0, straight deductible 10.0, minimum claim 10,000) are all visible from one careful read and will be found. Its own reference must then decide the stand figure of a plot that is not hail-thinned and the replant line of a replanting under 10 acres; the procedure gives both a line but no value, so the reference holds the solver's opinion. The instruction's reach sentence says keep today's calculation with today's constants. The minimum loss and minimum claim live in a shared figure table read through a step map; the natural minimal fix edits trace_tenths and small_cents in place and silently moves today's trace steps for exactly those silent items. A solver that reads STEPS and forks the entries keeps both; one that edits in place, or reads 3.1/6.1 as the only figures (nought for the rest), or 'tidies' the trace steps away, fails the trap.

score_notes.restraint_traps: two traps of one kind (shared-table reach) on different entries, files and definitions; each guards an in-place edit, an exclusion reading and an apply-everywhere reading; one careful read of figures.py STEPS disarms both, so they are correlated
score_notes.fuzz_blind_spot: TA needs a plot losing fewer than one plant in ten with a figure of 5.0-7.9 per cent; TB a replanting of 0.9-3.3 acres; a solver fuzzing against its own reference only tests its own reading

decisive_reason: the same mechanism held 1/2 on supplier-rebate (claude-opus-5); both traps fall to one careful read of the step map, so a 2/2 is plausible
